variants.hook: Manual reconciliation is where the hours go.
variants.body:
Manual reconciliation is where the hours go.

Every week, someone on the operations team sits with the inventory list and the order records and checks them by hand. That is not a data quality problem for IT to fix. It is an operations problem, and it shows up in lost hours.

In a pilot across 14 warehouses, teams using automated data checks cut the time spent on manual reconciliation by 31%.

The checks run on a schedule. They compare inventory records with order and shipment records and flag mismatches for a person to review. They do not change any records themselves.

The person still decides. The hours stop disappearing into the spreadsheet.
